notes: A CHEQUE NUMBER CAN NOW BE CORRECTED MORE THAN ONCE. Until this version, correcting a cheque a second time was refused: the register could remember one earlier version of a number and no more, so the app sent you to a fresh cheque rather than record something it could not describe honestly. That limit is gone. A cheque number now keeps its full history — every instrument it has stood for, in order — so a second, third or fourth correction is ordinary work. WHAT THIS PROTECTS. When a month has been reconciled and signed off and the correction only comes later, that month must still show the cheque as it was written: its original date and its original amount, because the month's cashbook still carries the payment. The register now holds exactly that, and the reconciliation still balances. Your existing cheques gain their history automatically the first time this version opens the books. A FAILED READ NO LONGER READS AS "GO AHEAD". When the app cannot read something it must not carry on as though the answer were "nothing found". Eight places are corrected: the over-budget confirmation on a commitment was skipped instead of shown; an invoice or vendor bill already posted could be edited underneath its own ledger entry; a stock take could re-book variances it had already booked; a petty-cash reimbursement could print listing fewer vouchers than its cheque paid for; correcting a payment could offer a fresh cheque for money that had already left the bank; the sub-ledger tie-out could report "nothing wrong" when it could not read its own settings; and registering a cheque could fail to see the entry already holding that number. Each now stops and says what could not be read. BEFORE YOU UPDATE: take a backup — Administration, Backup & Export, "Back up the database now" — as with any upgrade. This release adds to the cheque register's structure, and a backup taken beforehand is the one that restores the older shape if you ever need it.
